Sat Nav: UB9 5PG Parking There are two carparks run by Bucks County Council . Parking charges apply year round. Parking is not permitted on Denham Court Drive. For a full breakdown of parking and permit charges click here . Adventure Zone Children love the Adventure zone at Denham Country Park. It provides fun for all children up to 12 years old, some approach it as an obstacle course and some use each climbing or clambering item of equipment as a unique task whilst many younger ones are happy to bring a bucket and spade for the sand pit. Amenities There is the Adventure Zone, featured above, which is a large wooden playground that includes a sandpit. There is also a pretty, easy access, countryside walk of approximately one mile, that takes you through a wetland meadow, a woodland and past two rivers and the Grand Union Canal. These range from activities to occupy children during the holidays that take full advantage of our country setting.
